battle.name: 第十二次敘利亞戰役
battle.theater: 敘利亞北部奧龍特斯河谷
battle.brief: 公元前1442年，埃及第十八王朝法老圖特摩斯三世發動第十二次敘利亞戰役，大軍越西奈抵迦薩，沿奧龍特斯河谷北進，與米坦尼主導的敘利亞聯盟在阿勒頗一帶對峙。卡面這件埃及長矛出自早王朝，到此已是步兵通用長矛，與弓手、斧兵一同守在車兵突擊以外的陣線上。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是埃及新王國第十八王朝，與以米坦尼為核心的敘利亞—黎凡特聯盟。埃及一方以法老圖特摩斯三世為最高統帥，國王自領由王室成員與近衛構成的「神兵」車隊，駐於全軍中央；步兵主體是各郡徵集的埃及籍持矛兵與弓手，在編制上隸屬於軍隊書記官與「阿姆人」亞細亞裔軍官；車兵分成王室直轄與諸省供應的輕型雙輪戰車兩級。軍需自孟菲斯沿尼羅河用船運到卡爾納克與邊境口岸，再轉駱駝隊與驢車走西奈的商道北運。聯盟一方沒有統一統帥：卡爾基什、阿拉普、卡圖納、圖尼普等城邦各有國王與軍隊，名義上奉米坦尼的「偉大王」為宗主，實際各自為政，靠聯盟會議協調出兵與結盟；米坦尼的根據地在幼發拉底河上游的瓦舒卡尼，赫梯則在安納托利亞與敘利亞北面施加壓力，使聯盟背後始終有第二股力量支撐。雙方在迦薩以北沒有固定邊界，爭的是阿姆吉走廊、黎巴嫩山地的雪松林，以及通往幼發拉底河上游的道路。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Egyptian New Kingdom of the Eighteenth Dynasty and a Syrian-Levantine coalition with Mitanni at its core. On the Egyptian side the supreme commander was Pharaoh Thutmose III, who led the host in person with the divine escort, a body of charioteers drawn from the royal family and the household troops, stationed in the centre of the army; the infantry core was Egyptian spearmen and archers levied from the provinces, subordinated to the army scribes and to Amu commanders of Asiatic descent; the chariot arm was split into the king's own contingent and light two-wheeled chariots provided by the nomes. Supply moved by boat down the Nile from Memphis to Karnak and to the frontier depots, and was then taken north by camel train and donkey cart along the caravan roads of Sinai. The coalition had no single commander: Kadesh, Aleppo, Qatna, Tunip and the other city-states each had their own king and troops, nominally ranged under the great king of Mitanni but in practice autonomous, coordinating their levies and their alliances through a league council; the Mitanni base lay at Washukanni on the upper Euphrates, while the Hatti applied pressure from Anatolia and northern Syria, so that a second power stood behind the coalition throughout. Neither side had a fixed frontier north of Gaza; what was contested was the corridor of Amurru, the cedar slopes of Lebanon, and the road to the upper Euphrates.
people: 全場的核心是法老圖特摩斯三世。他自少年時即位，前半生的政績是守住上埃及與尼羅河三角洲；第一次北伐的教訓之後，他把敘利亞的戰線編進王曆，年年記上一場，編號一路排到第十七次，第十二次戰役正是這套「以年表宣示宗主權」的做法在晚年的一次延續。那時他的健康已大不如前，戰線多交由王室與將領處理，他本人仍保有親自出征的習慣，直到前一千四百二十五年去世，位置由其子阿蒙霍特普二世接去。敘利亞方面的關鍵人物是米坦尼王圖施拉塔：他在後來給阿蒙霍特普三世的書信中，一面求婚娶埃及王族女子以鞏固盟約，一面贈上等身高的金像，反映聯盟陣營並非鐵板一塊，也說明埃及的每一次北伐都在把這位對手往埃及這邊拉。赫梯方面在位的是穆爾西里二世，他與埃及之間的往來書信是兩大國直接交涉的開端，此後數十年，赫梯的介入讓敘利亞各邦多了一個可以倚仗的方向。埃及在北方的執行者，是一批以「阿姆人」身分任職的軍官與守備官，耶路撒冷與迦薩一帶的地方首領即由他們聯絡與約束；卡爾納克的王室書記官則把出發日期、行軍日數、繳獲清單與獻俘的場面逐條刻下來，這些銘文是今日重構第十二次戰役的主要依據。必須說明的是，本場戰役的具體指揮者姓名、接戰地點與經過，在現存材料中都沒有留下記載。
peopleEn: The hinge of the whole campaign is Pharaoh Thutmose III. He came to the throne as a boy, and the record of his first years is that of a king consolidating Upper Egypt and the Nile delta; after the lessons of the first northern expedition he wrote the Syrian front into the regnal annals, one campaign a year, and the numbering runs on to the seventeenth. The twelfth campaign is the late continuation of that practice of asserting suzerainty through the calendar. By then his health had much declined and the line was mostly left in the hands of the royal family and the generals, though the king kept the habit of taking the field himself, and he died in 1425 BC with the position passing to his son Amenhotep II. The decisive figure on the Syrian side was the Mitanni king Tushratta: in his later letters to Amenhotep III he asked for a daughter of the Egyptian royal house to cement the alliance and at the same time sent a life-size gold statue, which shows that the coalition was not a single block and that every Egyptian northern expedition pulled the enemy a little towards Egypt. On the Hittite side the king on the throne was Mursili II, whose correspondence with Egypt opens direct dealings between the two great powers; for decades afterwards the Hittite presence gave the Syrian states a second direction to lean towards. The men who carried out Egypt's order in the north were Amu officers and garrison commanders, who contacted and held in check the local rulers around Jerusalem and Gaza; and the royal scribes at Karnak cut into stone the departure dates, the days on the march, the lists of booty and the scenes of presenting prisoners, and those inscriptions are the principal evidence by which the twelfth campaign is reconstructed today. It has to be said that the names of the commanders, the place of contact and the course of the fighting are all missing from the surviving material.
kits: 本卡兵器是埃及長矛：早王朝時期以銅或青銅矛頭裝在木杆上的步戰長矛，埃及人用它守住城牆的出入口，也用它在外族入主時收復失地。到公元前一千四百四十二年，這種形制的長矛已不是新造之物，卻仍是埃及步兵最普遍的兵器之一。神兵車隊自營區出發後，留在營地與隘口周圍的是持矛兵與斧兵；軍隊集結時由他們排成圓陣，把車兵護在中央，向前推進時以矛頭朝前的密集縱隊跟隨車兵衝鋒，遇到對方戰車折衝就就地立定，以盾牆加長矛把人擋在陣外。埃及步兵的完整配備是長矛、銅刃短斧與前端的彎鉤斧、弓、皮盾與圓盾、銅或皮製頭盔，貴族與近衛另有銅鱗甲；車兵用輕型雙輪戰車、單對馬與六輻木輪，車上除御者外只載一名射手，配複合弓、銅鏃與木鏃箭，另備一支長矛。攻城裝備在圖特摩斯三世的浮雕上已有記載：繞輪的攻城塔、以槓桿操作的撞錘、掘壞牆基的坑道，當時歐洲尚未見攻城塔的形制，埃及的攻城技藝是地中海最早的一批。敘利亞與米坦尼方面的裝備以馬弓為主，箭袋與短弓便於騎射，車兵同樣用輕型雙輪或四輪車，但多帶長矛與彎刀，攻城則多靠圍城與封鎖。埃及後勤上的弱點也很清楚：糧食靠海船沿地中海海岸北運再轉駱駝隊，缺水時全軍依賴沙漠古道上的水窖與井，因此出征多選在春末至初夏，避開酷熱與枯水的月份。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Egyptian spear: a foot combat spear of the Early Dynastic period with a copper or bronze head socketed onto a wooden shaft, used by the Egyptians to hold the openings of their fortification walls and, later, to recover lost ground when foreigners took the country. By 1442 BC such a spear was long out of date as a new manufacture, yet it remained one of the commonest arms of the Egyptian infantry. When the divine escort of chariots rode out of the camp, the spearmen and axe-men were left around the camp and at the necks of the passes; on the line of march they drew up in a closed formation that shielded the chariots in the centre, and on the advance they followed the chariot charge in dense columns with the points forward, standing firm and blocking a charging enemy with shield wall and spear. The full Egyptian infantry kit was the spear, the copper-edged axe and a forward-curving hook blade, the bow, hide and round shields, copper or leather helmets, with copper scale armour reserved for the nobility and the guard; the chariotry used a light two-wheeled car, a single pair of horses and six-spoked wooden wheels, carrying a driver and a single archer, equipped with a composite bow, copper and wooden-tipped arrows and a spare spear. Siege equipment is already shown in the reliefs of Thutmose III: wheeled siege towers, lever-operated battering rams and saps cut under the base of a wall, at a time when no form of siege tower was yet known in Europe, which makes Egypt's siegecraft among the earliest in the Mediterranean. The equipment of the Syrian and Mitanni side was built on the horse bow: quivers and short bows suited to shooting from the saddle, and their chariots were likewise light two- or four-wheeled cars, but carrying more spears and curved sabres, while their siege work leaned on blockade and investment. The weak point on the Egyptian side lay in logistics: food came north by sea along the Mediterranean coast and was then transferred to camel trains, and in the absence of water the whole army depended on the cisterns and wells of the desert tracks, which is why the expeditions were timed for the late spring and early summer, avoiding the hot and dry months.
tactics: 埃及的戰法有固定次序。先由使者與地方首領試探對方的集結情形，再自迦薩或西奈的陸路北上，選擇水源與隘口扎營，把遠征縱隊拉成長條；接著以神兵車隊為尖刀，在清晨或黃昏發動短促衝鋒，國王自乘的雙馬戰車在箭雨下奔馳，衝散對方的車兵陣線，隨即撤回營地；步兵同時以持矛兵與弓手排成密集隊形，弓手自前排的矛縫之間放箭，把對方逼離水源，步兵不與對方車兵糾纏，只守住道路與渡口，等車兵回來再發動下一次衝鋒。攻城時用撞錘與攻城塔，圍城者必須先切斷城外的耕地與水井，逼守軍出城；防守的城邦則把縱深的外圍據點與田莊燒掉，把兵力收攏在城牆與神廟區，用投射武器與屋頂上的弓手拖住埃及人。聯盟軍的弱點是各城邦必須自己守自己的城，援軍抵達的時間先後不一，埃及人可以逐個對付；強點則在平原上車兵多，兩翼一旦拉開，埃及的神兵車隊難以重複衝鋒，須靠地形把車戰限制在狹窄的走廊。季候是戰術的一部分：多數戰役在舍姆月即埃及曆的春夏之交開打，於收穫前結束，糧秣吃緊；少數冬天作戰，如第八次跨越幼發拉底河那一次，選擇的是水位的時機而不是天氣。
tacticsEn: The Egyptian method followed a fixed order. Emissaries and local rulers were used first to test how the enemy was assembling; the army then moved north from Gaza or overland through Sinai, picking its camp sites at water and at the necks of passes and stretching the marching column out into a long line. Then the divine escort of chariots was used as the spearhead, striking in short, sharp attacks at dawn or at dusk: the king's own two-horse car rushed forward under the arrows, broke the enemy chariot line and fell back to the camp. At the same time the infantry formed up densely, spearmen and archers together, the archers shooting through the gaps between the spears in front and driving the enemy away from the water; the infantry did not get tangled with the enemy horse, holding the roads and the fords until the chariots returned for the next charge. Siege work used the ram and the tower, and a besieger had first to cut the fields and the wells outside the city in order to force the garrison out; the defending city-states in turn burned the outlying posts and the farms in depth, concentrated their strength on the walls and the temple quarter, and used missiles and roof archers to hold the Egyptians off. The weakness of the coalition was that each city-state had to defend its own city while the reinforcements arrived at different moments, so the Egyptians could deal with them one at a time; its strength lay in the mass of chariotry on the plains, for once the wings drew apart the Egyptian chariot thrust could not be repeated, and the fight had to be channelled into narrow corridors by the terrain. Season was part of the tactics: most campaigns opened in Shemu, the spring and early summer of the Egyptian calendar, and closed before the harvest when rations were tight; only a few were fought in winter, as in the eighth campaign, when the Euphrates was crossed, and there the choice was the moment of the water rather than the weather.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。圖特摩斯三世的統治橫跨約五十四年，約自前一千四百七十九年至前一千四百二十五年，編號戰役的序列自第一次一路排到第十七次，跨越二十年以上；按卡爾納克年表的編號與年序推算，第十二次戰役約當王曆三十八年，即公元前一千四百四十二年。每次北征的實際行程可以地圖估算：自孟菲斯經卡爾納克與西奈商道到迦薩，約九百公里；由迦薩沿沿海或經耶路撒冷與阿姆吉走廊到阿勒頗，約三百公里；再往北到幼發拉底河畔的卡爾基什，約五百五十公里。沙漠段每日行程約二十五至三十公里，一支車兵縱隊自埃及邊境走到奧龍特斯河谷要兩到三週。編制方面，卡爾納克浮雕與貢賦清單顯示王室車隊以數百輛計，聯盟方面的戰車同樣以百輛計；一次戰役繳獲的馬匹、銅器、金銀器皿、象牙與戰車，量級在數百件，俘獲的地方首領與家屬以數百計。卡爾納克的年表只留下編號的戰役清單，後段沒有詳細敘事，這是第十二次戰役難以核對的直接原因；能確定的只有，它排在第十一次與第十三次之間，時間在前一千四百四十二年前後。往後看，這條戰線的編號戰役一直排到公元前一千四百三十七年前後；圖特摩斯三世於前一千四百二十五年去世，阿蒙霍特普二世即位後不再重啟同規模的北征。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. Thutmose III's reign spans about fifty-four years, from about 1479 to 1425 BC, and the numbered campaigns run from the first to the seventeenth, covering more than two decades; judged from the numbering and the order of the Karnak annals, the twelfth campaign falls at about regnal year 38, that is 1442 BC. The actual distance covered by each northern expedition can be estimated from a map: from Memphis by way of Karnak and the roads of Sinai to Gaza is about nine hundred kilometres; from Gaza along the coast, or by the Jerusalem and Amurru corridor, to Aleppo is about three hundred; and on to Carchemish on the Euphrates is about five hundred and fifty. On the desert leg the column covered about twenty-five to thirty kilometres a day, so that a chariot column took two to three weeks to reach the Orontes valley from the Egyptian border. On the figures of strength, the reliefs and the tribute lists at Karnak show the royal chariot force counted in the hundreds, and the coalition's chariots likewise numbered in hundreds; the horses, copper, gold and silver vessels, ivory and chariots taken in a single campaign ran to hundreds of items, and the local rulers and their households taken prisoner to hundreds of persons. The Karnak annals preserve only the numbered list of campaigns, with no narrative for the later ones, and that is the direct reason why the twelfth campaign cannot be checked in detail; what can be fixed is that it stands between the eleventh and the thirteenth, at around 1442 BC. Looking further ahead, the numbered campaigns on this front run on until about 1437 BC; Thutmose III died in 1425 BC, and Amenhotep II, who succeeded him, did not open a northern campaign on the same scale again.
cause: 打起來的緣由，是埃及向北擴張與敘利亞諸邦不肯讓步的結構性對撞。第十八王朝早年在尼羅河谷與西奈的商道上已握有餘地，到這一步，埃及要的除了迦薩的商路，還有黎巴嫩山地的雪松、奧龍特斯河谷的穀物，以及通往北方銀礦與紫骨螺的路徑，而每一樣都要穿過別人的城邦。敘利亞這邊，米坦尼自更早的年代起便以偉大王的身分對黎凡特各邦發號施令，但那些城邦同時與赫梯往來，形成兩大國之間的緩衝地帶，不肯完全倒向任何一方。埃及的策略是先立威信再立秩序：每打完一場，就把地方首領帶回埃及，換上順從的阿姆人首領，再以編號的年表把這些遠征刻成法老統治的功業。於是第十二次戰役的起因與前面十一場並無不同，聯盟不甘淪為附庸，埃及必須用一次比一次深入的遠征證明邊界由誰來畫；只是到了這一場，雙方都清楚對方不會有決定性的崩潰，戰爭於是拖成一場以敲打、交換人質與年年進貢維持的長期消耗。
causeEn: The reason this war broke out lies in the structural collision between Egyptian expansion to the north and the refusal of the Syrian states to give way. The Eighteenth Dynasty already held the Nile valley and the caravan roads of Sinai, and by this point Egypt wanted not only the trade of Gaza but the cedar of Lebanon, the grain of the Orontes valley and the roads to the northern silver mines and murex, and every one of those had to pass through somebody else's city. On the Syrian side, Mitanni had for some time been acting as great king over the Levantine states, but those states dealt with the Hatti at the same time, forming a buffer between the two great powers and declining to throw in their lot wholly with either. Egypt's method was to establish prestige first and order afterwards: after each campaign the local rulers were brought back to Egypt and replaced by compliant Amu chiefs, and the expeditions were then cut into stone as works of the pharaoh's reign. The cause of the twelfth campaign was therefore no different from that of the eleven before it: the coalition would not consent to become a client, and Egypt had to prove by ever deeper expeditions who was drawing the border. Only by this campaign did both sides grasp that neither would collapse decisively, and the war turned into a long attrition maintained by raids, exchanges of hostages and an annual tribute.
impact: 第十二次戰役本身留下的文字不多，但它落在埃及北進路線的尾段，往後看得見的後果主要在三方面。其一，埃及沒有把敘利亞變成行省。第十二次之後，埃及的實際控制停在迦薩、耶路撒冷、阿姆吉與利塔尼河口的耶諾阿姆一線，以及米吉多等若干守備點，北方各邦改以進貢與互遣人質維持關係；米坦尼也沒有被消滅，聯盟在往後百年間一直是埃及在北方的對手，直到青銅時代末期換成赫梯直接支配敘利亞。其二，黎凡特各城邦在兩大國之間的位置越來越微妙，阿瑪爾納書信裡米坦尼王求娶埃及王族女子、贈送金像的記載，正說明聯盟陣營內部的選擇並不齊一，埃及的每一次遠征都讓這些城邦多一點可以周旋的空間。其三，遠征帶回的人力、馬匹與財物，成為卡爾納克工程與帝王葬禮的物質基礎之一；圖特摩斯三世晚年的注意力轉向努比亞與卡爾納克，前一千四百二十五年他去世後，阿蒙霍特普二世、圖特摩斯四世與阿蒙霍特普三世都沒有再發動同規模的北征，第十八王朝由擴張轉為守成，埃及在亞洲的門戶半開半掩，直到拉美西斯二世時代與赫梯在卡爾德什重開大戰，敘利亞的歸屬才被徹底重畫。
impactEn: The twelfth campaign left little writing of its own, but it sits at the tail of Egypt's northward advance, and the consequences visible afterwards run in three directions. First, Egypt did not turn Syria into a province. After the twelfth campaign Egyptian control rested on the line of Gaza, Jerusalem, Amurru and Yenoam at the mouth of the Litani, together with a handful of garrison points such as Megiddo, and the northern states thereafter maintained the relationship through tribute and the exchange of hostages; Mitanni was not destroyed either, and the coalition remained Egypt's opponent in the north for the next century, until late in the Bronze Age the Hatti took over the direct lordship of Syria. Second, the position of the Levantine city-states between the two great powers grew ever more delicate, and the Amarna letters in which the Mitanni king asks for a daughter of the Egyptian royal house and sends a gold statue show precisely that the coalition was not united in its choices; every Egyptian expedition left those city-states a little more room to manoeuvre. Third, the manpower, horses and goods dragged back from these expeditions formed part of the material basis of the works at Karnak and of the royal funerary cult; in his last years Thutmose III turned his attention to Nubia and to Karnak, and after his death in 1425 BC neither Amenhotep II, Thutmose IV nor Amenhotep III opened a northern campaign on the same scale. The Eighteenth Dynasty turned from expansion to consolidation, and Egypt's door into Asia stood half open, until the reign of Ramesses II and the renewed war against the Hatti at Qadesh redrew the ownership of Syria altogether.
result: 打完的結果，是一次沒有勝負的僵持。埃及沒有攻下北方大城，聯盟也沒有把埃及逐出迦薩；圖特摩斯三世把戰果換成了實物，馬匹、牲畜、金銀器皿、象牙、戰車與俘獲的地方首領，編入下一次遠征的補給，並在卡爾納克的浮雕與貢賦清單上逐項登記。聯盟內部則以進貢、歸還俘虜與互派人質維持表面的服從，有限的抵抗集中在迦薩以北的山地與邊境據點，埃及的巡邏隊與阿姆人守備官在這些地方與地方首領反覆拉鋸。編號的年表照樣把這場戰役記成法老的一次成功，第十三次乃至第十七次戰役的名目繼續排下去，說明王室的敘事需要的不是戰果，而是秩序的外觀。真正的變化在編號之外：埃及承認了米坦尼在北方的現實存在，敘利亞則確認了埃及在南方的勢力，這種互相承認的均勢維持了近兩百年；前一千四百二十五年圖特摩斯三世去世，第十八王朝的對外政策一路收縮，這條北方的戰線也就此收束。
resultEn: The outcome was a stalemate without a victor. Egypt took no great northern city, and the coalition did not drive Egypt out of Gaza; Thutmose III converted the results into material, and the horses, livestock, gold and silver vessels, ivory, chariots and captured local rulers were entered into the supply of the next expedition and itemised in the reliefs and tribute lists at Karnak. Inside the coalition, submission on the surface was maintained by tribute, the return of prisoners and the exchange of hostages, and what resistance there was concentrated in the hill country and frontier posts north of Gaza, where Egyptian patrols and Amu garrison commanders fought a long running duel with the local rulers. The numbered annals nonetheless entered the campaign as one of the pharaoh's successes, and the names of the thirteenth and even the seventeenth campaigns went on being listed, which shows that what the court's account needed was not a result but the appearance of order. The real change lay outside the numbering: Egypt accepted Mitanni's effective existence in the north, and Syria confirmed Egypt's strength in the south, and that mutual recognition held for close to two hundred years. Thutmose III died in 1425 BC, the foreign policy of the Eighteenth Dynasty contracted from then on, and this northern front was closed for good.
